from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from time import perf_counter
from types import FunctionType
import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from terra_prisca.haze_world import turnover as t

case='basin_resolved_f0.9_08_M_into_A_res0'
source=t.sources();raw=t.RAW
record=next(json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in raw.glob(case+'_t1e+06-*.receipt.json') if json.loads(p.read_text())['protocol']['source_sha256']==source)
item=record['protocol'];p=t.params(item['fraction'],item['loss_h'])
baseline=np.load(raw/record['raw_file'])
protocol=dict(source_sha256=source,case_id=case,years=1000000,initial=item['initial'],sample_every_years=100,
 method='BDF, explicit scaled central-difference Newton matrix, exact invariant initial face; all rtol and atol10x tighter than qualified Radau; max_step1000yr; original positive initial stocks;120s wall guard')
started=perf_counter();original=t.solve_ivp

def backend(fun,*args,**kwargs):
    def bounded(time,state):
        if perf_counter()-started>120:raise TimeoutError('Bounded cycle control exceeded120 seconds')
        return fun(time,state)
    kwargs.update(method='BDF',rtol=kwargs['rtol']/10,atol=np.asarray(kwargs['atol'])/10)
    return original(bounded,*args,**kwargs)

namespace=t.integrate_basin.__globals__.copy();namespace['solve_ivp']=backend
function=FunctionType(t.integrate_basin.__code__,namespace,t.integrate_basin.__name__,t.integrate_basin.__defaults__,t.integrate_basin.__closure__)
result=function(item['initial'],p,1000000,sample_times=np.arange(0.,1000001.,100.))
if t.sources()!=source:raise RuntimeError('T1 sources changed during cycle control')
destination=t.RAW.parent/'cycle_control';destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
file=destination/'basins_cycle_control_BDF.npz';np.savez_compressed(file,t=result.t,y=result.y,log_biomass=result.log_biomass)

def diagnostics(time,stocks,logs):
    minima=[]
    for guild in (0,1):
        indices,_=find_peaks(-logs[guild],prominence=5)
        minima.append([dict(time_yr=float(time[i]),log_biomass=float(logs[guild,i])) for i in indices])
    late=time>500000;temperature=t.core.temperature_k(stocks[4],p.climate)
    crossings=[]
    for i in range(len(time)-1):
        if stocks[4,i]<.18<=stocks[4,i+1]:
            fraction=(.18-stocks[4,i])/(stocks[4,i+1]-stocks[4,i]);when=time[i]+fraction*(time[i+1]-time[i])
            if when>400000:crossings.append(dict(time_yr=float(when),stocks=(stocks[:,i]+fraction*(stocks[:,i+1]-stocks[:,i])).tolist(),log_biomass=(logs[:,i]+fraction*(logs[:,i+1]-logs[:,i])).tolist()))
    return dict(log_minima=minima,late_temperature_range_k=[float(min(temperature[late])),float(max(temperature[late]))],
                late_ratio_range=[float(min(stocks[4,late])),float(max(stocks[4,late]))],upward_ratio_018_crossings=crossings)

answer=dict(protocol=protocol,baseline_fingerprint=record['fingerprint'],baseline_raw_sha256=record['raw_sha256'],
 raw_file=str(file.relative_to(t.e.ROOT)),raw_sha256=sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),wall_seconds=perf_counter()-started,nfev=result.nfev,
 minimum_chemical_stock=float(np.min(result.y[[0,3,4]])),
 baseline=diagnostics(baseline['t'],baseline['y'],baseline['log_biomass']),control=diagnostics(result.t,result.y,result.log_biomass),
 qualification='Independent stiff solver and tighter tolerances test the recurring path; no claim of mathematical periodic-orbit proof or global attractor completeness',
 review_script_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),review_script=Path(__file__).read_text())
(t.OUTPUT/'basins_cycle_control.json').write_text(json.dumps(answer,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:answer[k] for k in ['wall_seconds','nfev','minimum_chemical_stock','raw_sha256']},indent=2),flush=True)
print(json.dumps(dict(baseline=answer['baseline'],control=answer['control']),indent=2),flush=True)
